item.title: 智能体上下文层：治理 AI 数据的企业捕捉错误答案的数量是未治理者的两倍
item.summary: Across 101 enterprises, the context feeding AI agents is failing often and repeatedly. Sixty-eight percent have traced a confident but wrong agent answer to missing or inconsistent business context in the past six months, and the single most common answer is not "once" but "more than once."
